title: Factories slow to 54.7 as stock piles up
takeaways: 54.7: India manufacturing PMI in October, down from 55.1.
Record finished goods stock build in 21 years of survey data.
₹2.31 lakh crore gross GST in October, up 22.9%.
1.4%: growth in consumer non-durables, the weakest category.
source_note: Sources: HSBC/S&P Global PMI via ANI; Finance Ministry via The Tribune; PIB IIP
